about: T268: the launch budget. Ceilings in ms per stage of GET /debug/launch (shared launch/Launch.kt) and for the first frame and the map drawn, against the medians of tools/android-startup.py --launches 5 (cold, a seeded store) in the sweep's startup part; a median over its ceiling, or a StrictMode kind a stage's declared work does not allow, turns the part red.
rule: Set by android-startup.py --set-budget from the medians of two sweeps: the larger times the factor, rounded up to whole ms, and never under that median plus floorMs (one frame at 60 Hz; a stage of a few ms swings by more than a quarter of itself). Lower a ceiling by hand in the commit that lands an improvement; never raise one without a line in the dated log. A renamed stage keeps its ceiling through aliases, {old name: new name}.
